scope: Software state and scheduling contracts, not heldout predictive efficacy or hostile native containment.

evidence_retention.original_tool_outputs: Present in the active task tool transcript.
evidence_retention.note: No standalone raw stdout file was saved for these development contract runs. The fields below transcribe observed counts and messages; they are not reconstructed execution receipts.

initial_probe_failures.cause: Short startup contexts coexist with full-length contexts; the first table bound counted full-length contexts only.
initial_probe_failures.correction: Bound each table by the sum of binary context capacities through its order.

initial_probe_failures.cause: The original lag proposal diagnostic uses negative infinity when no finite candidate passes its training gate.
initial_probe_failures.correction: Encode only that diagnostic value as NO_FINITE_CANDIDATE; arbitrary nonfinite JSON remains refused.

independent_findings.finding: Standalone model public-prefix metadata could be relabeled without checking actual native/temporal history.
independent_findings.correction: Snapshot and restore compare the embedded ordered native/temporal history digest to the external prefix binding. Frequency-only order remains an explicitly documented external binding; controller restoration recomputes frequency counts from explicit history.

independent_findings.finding: Windows symbolic-link-only checks miss junction/reparse ancestors.
independent_findings.correction: Inspect unresolved target and existing ancestors with lstat; refuse symlink, reparse tag/attribute, and multiply linked checkpoint files. Native controlled junction test passed.

independent_findings.finding: Boolean True could alias integer state version one.
independent_findings.correction: Require exact integer type for predictor and concrete class version fields.

independent_findings.finding: Internally impossible controller chronology could survive a rehashed checkpoint.
independent_findings.correction: Check monotonic decision prefixes, selected mechanism against final decision, ordered alarms and cooldown, alarm arithmetic, and last-alarm/credit cursors.

independent_findings.finding: Generic nested counter/cache maps could survive restoration and fail on the next forecast.
independent_findings.correction: Check exact per-class counter keys and bounded concrete cache shapes before adoption.

independent_findings.finding: Full-warm abstention initially retained the all-learner execution path.
independent_findings.correction: Budget abstention performs only frequency bookkeeping; expensive native/temporal states are not built or updated.

independent_findings.finding: Memory-pressure eviction could be reversed by the next full-warm prediction.
independent_findings.correction: Persist residency_limit and enforce it during future build, selection, prediction, and restoration.

independent_findings.finding: Cold-switch eviction could exceed the accepted 512-event limit, and exhausted decisions could mutate state before refusal.
independent_findings.correction: Check decision and applicable eviction capacity before policy/model/exploration mutation.

independent_findings.finding: Only same-process restoration had initially been checked.
independent_findings.correction: Add a fresh Python process contract: restore a 256-observation native state with an actually promoted a3 lag and compare the next 32 forecasts exactly.

preregistration_design_corrections.change: E uses selectivewarm; I uses fullwarm.
preregistration_design_corrections.timing: Parent-directed architectural choice before any new development or heldout outcomes.
preregistration_design_corrections.reason: Fullwarm pays for all inactive native computation and receives additional actual public forecasts; it is a distinct ablation rather than a plausible primary cost-saving policy.

preregistration_design_corrections.change: Delayed exploratory commitment extends to ceil((n+C)/H)*H, capped by history and explicit remaining-step budget.
preregistration_design_corrections.reason: A normal C deadline could abandon a new learner before its initial H credit release.
preregistration_design_corrections.accounting: Estimated cost charges the extended prospective horizon; no-delayed uses the base C deadline and current last16 credit.

observed_test_sequence.failure: Native and temporal models were present after zero-step abstention.
observed_test_sequence.cause: The new prospective-deadline logic set a zero-budget abstention deadline to the current prefix, causing predict to immediately re-decide with default budget.
observed_test_sequence.correction: Retain abstention through the registered interval; do not immediately auto-decide with defaults.

limits: Test timings are contract-suite observations, not independent experiment performance samples.
No software contract establishes general forecasting, coding, or intelligence advantage.
Checkpoint checksum/source bindings are local integrity, not authentication against replacement of state and trust anchors.
Logical expiry requires an external current epoch; model eligibility requires an external accepted public-prefix binding.
Storage and resident learner bounds are not a strict RSS guarantee.
Fullwarm/selective/cold comparisons differ in paid inactive forecasts and feedback as well as persistence.
The packed lag epoch cache is rebuilt after restoration; its process-local row identities are never imported.
